description: Use first when a user asks a money math question in plain words, such as "how much will $500 a month grow in 20 years?", "when can I retire if I spend $40,000 a year?", "how long to pay off $5,000 on my credit card at 24% paying $200 a month?", "how much do I need to save each month to have $50,000 in 5 years?", "how long to double my money at 8%?" or "am I getting my full 401(k) match?". Reads the amounts, rates, ages and years from the question, picks the matching Compound Mint calculator (compound interest, Rule of 72, FIRE number, Coast FIRE, 401(k) match, debt payoff, savings goal), runs it and returns the answer with what it understood, the explanation, the assumptions, source_page to cite and related_reading. When a needed number is missing it returns status need_more_info with the exact question to ask the user.

question.description: The money question in plain words, with any amounts, rates, ages and years, e.g. "How much will $500 a month grow in 20 years at 8%?"

name: answer_money_question
title: Answer a money question
